pictures.name: out_of_the_depths
pictures.scene: the bottom of a deep dry well seen from within, its wet stone walls rising away on every side and a small circle of daylight far above, the stones near the floor lit faintly and everything between black

pictures.name: still_night_water
pictures.scene: a wide dark lake lying under a clear night sky with one long band of starlight on the water, the near shore stones lit faintly at the bottom of the frame, the middle of the water deep and unbroken

pictures.name: tablets_laid_down
pictures.scene: two blank stone tablets resting flat on bare rock beneath an empty sky, their surfaces smooth and unmarked, lit low and warm along their nearest edge, the rock and sky above them dim and open

pictures.name: yoke_laid_down
pictures.scene: a heavy wooden yoke set down on the ground with its straps loosened and hanging free, the worn timber lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the field beyond it opening away into quiet shade

pictures.name: lamp_kept_burning
pictures.scene: one small oil lamp burning steadily on a broad windowsill of cut stone, its flame low and its glow pooling on the sill at the bottom of the frame, the night beyond the opening deep and starless

pictures.name: wall_before_dawn
pictures.scene: the parapet of a high stone wall seen from behind at the last of the night, the cold stone lit faintly along its lowest edge, the eastern sky beyond it just beginning to pale above deep darkness

pictures.name: first_line_of_dawn
pictures.scene: a long low horizon with one thin bright seam of gold breaking along it, the dark land beneath lit just enough to show its nearest ridges, the whole sky above it still deep and heavy with night

pictures.name: full_daylight_on_the_land
pictures.scene: a wide green valley opened out under full morning light, its nearest meadow and stream lit warm and clear along the bottom of the frame, the far hills above rising soft and quiet into a bright sky

lines.text: I cry to You, O LORD!
let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities,
then who, O Lord, could stand?
But with You there is forgiveness,
so that You may be feared.
I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait,
and in His word I put my hope.
My soul waits for the Lord
more than watchmen wait for the morning—
more than watchmen wait for the morning.
O Israel, put your hope in the LORD,
for with the LORD is loving devotion,
and with Him is redemption in abundance.
